verdict.rationale: EBANX documents its own recurring payments capability: recurring Pix with automatic debit authorization, plus a Recurring Payments solution with tokenized cards and smart retry logic. That covers the core of charging customers repeatedly. Nothing in the evidence shows subscription-management primitives such as plan objects, trial periods, upgrade/downgrade handling or proration. missing for 10: plan/price definitions, trial periods, subscription upgrades/downgrades, proration logic, subscription API docs, independent corroboration.
